title: Juicy Polish Garlic Risotto
description: A hearty, garlicky Polish dish featuring seasoned rice vinegar, pasta-water emulsion, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients. Perfect for adventurous eaters seeking a vessel-friendly meal.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality, fresh garlic for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Pasta water
ingredients.notes: Reserved from cooking pasta, used for emulsion.

ingredients.name: Seasoned rice vinegar
ingredients.notes: Store-bought or homemade vinegar seasoned with spices and herbs.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Unrefined, pure salt for added flavor.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Extra virgin olive oil for added richness.

instructions: Heat olive oil in a ramekin over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add Arborio rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add seasoned rice vinegar and pasta water, stirring constantly, until liquid is absorbed.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
